expectations.text: States the law has 5 chapters and 39 articles, not nine chapters
expectations.evidence: States 'the Law has FIVE chapters and 39 articles, not nine'

expectations.text: Places the personal data protection core in Chapter II (Articles 9-32)
expectations.evidence: Chapter table: 'II | Personal Data Protection | 9-32' and calls Arts. 9-32 the operative rules

expectations.text: Correctly names at least two sector-specific articles among Arts. 25-32 (for example recruitment/employees Art. 25, finance/banking Art. 27, big data/AI/cloud Art. 30)
expectations.evidence: Names recruitment/employee (25), finance/banking/credit (27), big data/AI/blockchain/metaverse/cloud (30) among others

expectations.text: States Article 38 is entry into force (January 1, 2026) and includes the SME/startup five-year opt-out
expectations.evidence: 'Art. 38 contains both the effective date (1 January 2026) and the 5-year SME/startup opt-out from Arts. 21, 22 and 33(2)'

expectations.text: States Article 39 carries the transitional provisions (Decree 13-era consents and dossiers remain valid)
expectations.evidence: 'Art. 39 keeps Decree 13-era consents and impact-assessment dossiers valid'
